positions.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Own the deployment lifecycle and cloud infrastructure for a large-scale HIPAA-regulated cloud environment, supporting one of the largest US behavioral health networks.
Develop IaC, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines across AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and Salesforce to deliver resilient production environments.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Taught Linux administration, shell scripting, networking, and open source tooling fundamentals to students in a fully remote learning environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Shell Scripting · Teaching · Linux System Administration · Bash

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
Built networks implementing Path Aware Networking (PAN) and SCION, a BGP-alternative
routing protocol, as an alternative to the existing Internet architecture.
Ported NATS to SCION to demonstrate the benefits of PAN and QUIC within a distributed messaging system.
positions.insights: Skills: SCION · Linux · NixOS · Networking · Go (Programming Language) · NATS · Routing · Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) · QUIC

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Scaled the consulting practice 4x while establishing engineering standards across 12 Fortune 500 partnerships.
Mentored engineers on distributed systems design, software development best practices, and engineering team culture.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Standardized release engineering and enforced environment isolation across AWS development, staging, and production.
Bootstrapped IaC AWS platform using SaltStack and Terraform, supporting all products.
Reduced operational overhead from 80% to 30% for a legacy AWS environment of 300 Ubuntu Linux servers deployed via Puppet, enabling rapid customer onboarding.
